method: Preliminary planning estimate, NOT a Canadian Electrical Code Rule 8-200/8-202 calculation.
steps: Apply the demand factor the designer chooses for each category.
Add continuous-load margin where the design requires it.
Convert demand kVA to amps: 3-phase 120/208 V: A = kVA x 1000 / (1.732 x 208); single-phase 120/240 V: A = kVA x 1000 / 240.
Round up to a standard service size.
note: Kitchen equipment demand of 80% is a common planning assumption for multiple appliances; the governing demand calculation for permit is the CEC Section 8 method applied by the electrical designer, and the ESA inspection governs in Ontario.
